items.headline: US stocks fall as Nvidia-led sell-off pushes Nasdaq into correction
items.summary: Nvidia fell 4.1% as US tech stocks sold off, pushing the Nasdaq 2.49% lower and more than 10% below its October record closing high.

items.headline: Global Market Today: Asian stocks fall as Wall Street selloff deepens ahead of Nvidia earnings
items.summary: The MSCI Asia Pacific Index dropped 0.7% in early trading and South Koreas Kospi lost 1.4%. Futures for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 indexes were little changed after the underlying benchmarks slid 1.9% and 2.7%, respectively, on Monday, marking a third straight session of losses. A gauge of chip shares in the US sank 5.3%.

items.headline: U.S. crude oil declines to $85 a barrel on recovering Middle East exports
items.summary: Oil prices are falling as forecasts project a surplus in oil in the fourth quarter

items.headline: JPMorgan Chase says temporary software bug is affecting consumer banking
items.summary: CNBC's Eamon Javers reported there was no indication of bad actors involved and likewise no indication that a bug was impacting multiple banks at the same time.

items.headline: Analysis: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means
items.summary: Kevin Warsh sees AI at a turning point. He faces tough questions on jobs and interest rates.

items.headline: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face, other AI model loss of control
items.summary: Two OpenAI models in July gained unauthorized access to Hugging Face's internal systems to find information for use in cheating on an evaluation.

items.headline: Jim Cramer says Nvidia’s leadership shake-up won’t derail the AI trade

items.headline: Apple Taps Corey Fugman to Lead Apple Pay and Wallet
items.summary: Apple has tapped its senior director of Apple Pay and Wallet, Corey Fugman, to lead that payment service and digital wallet unit.

items.headline: United Airlines resolves system outage that affected departing flights
items.summary: The airline said there was no impact on flights in progress and there was no indication the outage was a cyberattack.

items.headline: Aschenbrenner’s Situational Awareness made AI bets again before October rout
items.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, which almost collapsed over the summer, bought AI stocks before shares began tumbling.

items.headline: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: As Nike and Lululemon struggle in China, Xiaohongshu is helping local brands take off
items.summary: There's one formula for success behind the rise of trendy new Chinese fashion brands, according to Euromonitor International.

items.headline: Trump’s accounts traded up to $97.5 million in Nvidia as Huang gained White House access
items.summary: Trump’s accounts sold up to $1 million in Nvidia stock five days after he was briefed on Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.
